description: In SqliteLogStorage::insert_entry (and insert_entry_and_advance_tips), the parent CIDs are inserted with a loop executing one INSERT per parent. A QueryBuilder bulk INSERT could insert all parents in a single statement. For an article with many parent CIDs (rare but possible when merging diverged DAGs), this is O(p) round-trips where a single statement would suffice.
title: core: insert_entry loops over parent CIDs one-by-one instead of bulk inserting
